strings.md.entities.domains.heading: Domains
strings.md.entities.domains.note: A domain is an area of the map. What it does lists only the purposes of its features that were verified, in the words of their entries.
strings.md.entities.domain.counts: Features: {features}. Features with a verified entry: {verified}.
strings.md.entities.roles.heading: Roles
strings.md.entities.roles.note: For each role, what the verified entries of the features say the role can do. This is what the entries say, not a list of permissions.
strings.md.matrix.roleFeature.heading: Roles by feature
strings.md.matrix.roleFeature.note: A cell holds what the verified entry of the feature says the role can do. An empty cell means the entry says nothing about the role. This is not a list of permissions.
strings.md.entities.applications.heading: Applications in detail
strings.md.entities.applications.note: A feature is listed under the application in which its quoted passages fall, with the number of passages; a passage belongs to the application with the longest matching directory. Only verified entries are counted. This does not say that the application implements the feature.
strings.md.entities.app.featuresHeading: Features whose quoted passages fall in this application
strings.md.entities.app.domainsHeading: Domains whose features have quoted passages in this application
strings.md.entities.app.jobsHeading: Scheduled jobs registered in files of this application
strings.md.entities.app.shownHeading: External systems that list this application as a caller, in the quoted code
strings.md.entities.app.namedHeading: External systems whose name appears in the source of this application
strings.md.entities.unattributed.heading: Quoted passages in no application
strings.md.entities.unattributed.note: Passages of verified entries that fall in no application directory. They are counted here so that none is dropped.
strings.md.entities.systems.heading: External systems in detail
strings.md.entities.systems.note: Called by, in the quoted code: the applications the verified overview lists for the system, each checked against its quoted passages. Applications whose source contains the name: found by the script in the source files of each application, the name as written (same capitals), in code or in a comment. That says the name appears there, not that the application calls the system. Test files and skipped directories are not searched.
strings.md.entities.system.named: Applications whose source contains the name
strings.md.entities.system.namedOutside: Source files outside every listed application that contain the name: {count}.
strings.md.matrix.applicationDomain.heading: Applications by domain
strings.md.matrix.applicationDomain.note: A cell is the number of quoted passages of the domain's verified features that fall in the application. An empty cell means none.
strings.md.locations.heading: Source locations
strings.md.locations.note: For each item, the file and the lines of each passage quoted for it.
strings.md.locations.overviewHeading: Source locations of the system overview
strings.md.coverage.heading: Coverage
strings.md.coverage.conserved: Entrypoint candidates listed: {total}. In exactly one feature: {assigned}. In the unassigned list below: {unassigned}. None is missing and none is counted twice.
strings.md.coverage.reachHeading: Features by how readers get to them
strings.md.coverage.linkHeading: Features reached only by a link
strings.md.coverage.allWritten: Every feature has a verified entry.
strings.md.coverage.removedHeading: Items removed because the code did not back them up
strings.md.verdict.unverified: The code shown does not settle it
strings.md.verdict.withParent: Removed together with the item it belongs to
strings.md.summary.notifications.heading: All notifications
strings.md.summary.notifications.counts: Features with a verified entry: {verified} of {total}. Notifications listed: {count}. The notifications of the other features are not in this table; see the coverage section.
strings.md.summary.notifications.note: Each row is one notification of a verified entry, in the words of the entry. Rows are not merged and channel names are not unified.
strings.md.summary.notifications.none: No verified entry has a notification.
strings.md.summary.jobs.heading: All scheduled jobs
strings.md.summary.jobs.counts: Scheduled jobs listed: {total}. Schedule written on the registration line: {literal}. Schedule worked out when the job is registered: {computed}. Schedule not in the text of the registration line: {absent}. Rows with a verified description: {described}.
strings.md.summary.jobs.note: Not in this table: the time zone, how many instances run a job, and whether a job can safely run twice. A line that registers several jobs in a loop is one row. Scheduling libraries that the candidate list does not cover are not in the table.
strings.md.summary.schedule.computed: Worked out when the job is registered
strings.md.summary.schedule.absent: Not in the text of the registration line
